Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.200 of 2022, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Laliya, District Balrampur.
3. It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is father-in-law.
He further argues that mother-in-law has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 31.01.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.7719 of 2023.

sentences.text: 4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that the co-accused has been enlarged on bail coupled with the fact that the Rajitram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5184036/
1 applicant is aged about 57 years and has no criminal antecedent, on the same reasoning as contained in the order dated 31.01.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.

entities.text: Rajitram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rajitram be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
